cause: The initial password regex captured Han label prose rather than the credential value in the authorized two-token source line.
impact: Two visible login attempts were rejected before any Reader question was submitted; logout removed the prior browser token and no token or credential was persisted.
resolution: Require exactly two whitespace tokens, an all-Han first token containing the password label, and a non-Han second token; use only the second token in memory.

cause: The browser authentication storage disappeared after the correction05 native baseline and both Portal tabs redirected to Login.
impact: The first runner launch stopped before creating a conversation or submitting any Reader question. Pressing Enter on the visible login form did not issue an authentication request.
resolution: Used the previously verified two-token credential parser and the unique visible Login control for one authentication request, then required fresh GetUserInfo source-email, Happiness Center Manager role, and tickets permission matches before starting correction05.

impact: The correction06 pilot paused after completed CH02 and CT04 groups; IN02 and FN02 were deferred until the Admin Portal entry point recovered.
action: No authentication request was retried after the definitive network failure; task space 85 remained agent-owned on Login.

resolution.cause: The Admin Portal Vite process serving localhost:18086 was not running.
resolution.verification: After the Portal process was restored, the audit UI hard refresh loaded styles.css with 173 CSS rules and app.js with the intended layout; the Portal login UI loaded and the next serialized POST /api/AdminUser/Login completed with HTTP 200 before fresh GetUserInfo.
